title: security.alert (v1)
description: An audit event carried an alertable security signal (AUD-012): refresh-token reuse, support-access activity or denial, cross-tenant denial, factor recovery, signing-key change, bootstrap, credential issuance or compromise, emergency action (every event in the emergency category), a sign-in by a protected account, a sign-in that a realm authentication_flow rule let proceed for review (authentication_review), an assignment of a privileged role (an owner role, a realm role, or a role carrying a permission the catalog marks privileged, directly or through a composed role; built-in member and admin organization roles are not privileged), or a security-relevant configuration change (realm.policy.updated, federation.provider.*, hook.created, hook.updated, webhook.created, audit.legal_hold.released). Published in the same transaction as the audit event it refers to, so it exists exactly when the evidence committed; audit events without a realm (operator CLI events) raise no alert. The alert carries identifiers only; read the audit event for details. The minimal payload form keeps every member: they are identifiers, types and the signal name, never personal data.

data.description: Event data: identifiers, types and the signal. Both payload forms carry the same members.

signal.description: The bounded signal name (also the label of proudauth_security_signals_total).

audit_event_id.description: ID (evt_...) of the audit event that raised the alert; fetch it with GET /audit-events?id=<audit_event_id>.

event_type.description: The audit event type, for example role.assigned.

actor_type.description: Actor type of the audit event: user, service_principal, client or system.

actor_id.description: Actor ID of the audit event.

subject_type.description: Subject type of the audit event, when it has a subject.

subject_id.description: Subject ID of the audit event, when it has a subject.

org_id.description: Set when the audit event belongs to an organization; organization-scoped subscriptions then receive the alert.

x-emitted-by: internal/runtime/deps.go: audit Recorder Alert hook (every audit event with a security signal)
